title: Each batch review lists every lane PR that work could be lost on
why:
Owner 09:50 CST Nov 13: "do we have somethign checking for all the lost work?" Today only the retrospective's one-time audit (09:31 CST) checks it; part 3 of step handin-cannot-drop covers only done PRs not batched after 6 h. Tonight runner 10 found 111 done PRs never batched.

12:05 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 11:59, relayed; its pick, mine, undoable): lost-work-sweep builds a NEW branch from main with only its own lost-work parts plus the local-git holds_head, in a new PR. #3148 and #3170 become replaced; runner 10 closes them with "Replaced by <new PR>". #3322 is retargeted to the new PR (the lane's job). Reason: main's per-lane merge (commit d8c16a7711) removed the batch flags #3148 is built on.

12:36 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; its pick, none owner-typed, undoable): pick 5 (option A): fresh branch from main with its own parts; PRs 3148 and 3170 become replaced; PR 3322 retargets to its new PR.

12:36 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; its pick, none owner-typed, undoable): pick 5 (option A): fresh branch from main with its own parts; PRs 3148 and 3170 become replaced; PR 3322 retargets to its new PR.

12:43 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; its pick, none owner-typed, undoable; triage read no lane): new hand-in #3528 (lost-work-sweep route A, round 1 running; replaces #3148 and #3170), with runner 10. Two picks (coordinator's, not owner-typed): state (b) needs a log older than 6 h; a PR whose log is carried (`Replaces #M`) lists no (a)/(b) row.
note: At each batch review the batch runner lists every open lane PR in one of five states: (a) done and in no batch for more than 6 h; (b) record open and the lane not told; (c) no review record and the lane idle more than 12 h; (d) lane archived, PR still open; (e) PR on a step marked doing with the lane gone. Each row goes to the session that owns its fix. Cost: one merge --reviewed run plus the live file, inside the batch review already running; no new process or log. Test cases: #2816, #2848, #3057 (a); #2917, #2817, #2957 (b); #2963 (c); #2932 (d). Builds on handin-cannot-drop parts 1-3 (same reader); kept separate because (b)-(e) read lanes, not batches. For the owner to rank. Ruling backlog-drain-plan, part 2 (owner 10:45 CST Nov 13): the ledger roadmap/backlog/lost-prs.json on the record branch, written only by a script, never by hand. One row per PR: step, state, age, files touched, verdict (keep, duplicate, rebuild, merged). It reruns at each batch review. The count of rows with no final verdict is the one number everyone reports. Step backlog-drain drains it. Lane started by the coordinator 10:48 CST Nov 13 (R66 part 2). Express (owner 10:54 CST Nov 13, ruling drain-first-hold part 4): goes ahead of the drain.
